evidence: Kernel checks cu_seqlens_q/k ([0]==0, non-decreasing, [-1]==Tq/Tk) before any data access and returns without touching memory on violation (status word + torch._assert_async). Wrapper: seq_meta= accepted (validated SequenceMeta, no sync); max_seqlen_q=None -> validate_varlen_packing (one D2H, ValueError); GatedAttentionFn builds the meta in forward when grads are needed. Tests test_host_validation_rejects_bad_offsets[q_end_short,q_end_long,k_end_long,q_start,q_decreasing] and test_device_checks_fail_closed[q_end_beyond_rows,k_end_beyond_rows] (subprocess) fail on f91e8b6 and pass here. NaN pre-fill of outputs not added: with the coverage check (R2) no row can stay unwritten without the assert firing; a pre-fill would cost 3 memsets per call.

Coverage is checked in the kernel: len_q > rows of grid axis 0 (HEAD: num_programs(0); TOKEN: num_programs(0)*64) sets the status word -> device-side assert. Tests test_device_checks_fail_closed[max_seqlen_short_auto (review p1), max_seqlen_short_token, max_seqlen_short_head, max_seqlen_short_paged (review p1b)] fail on f91e8b6, pass here.

(a) a block-table entry < 0 under a key_ok key now fails closed (assert) instead of being masked, on global and local layers; (b) seq_lens > max_pages*16 and seq_lens < len_q are checked in the kernel (and on the host when max_seqlen_q is None); (c) page ids >= num_pages fail closed and are never dereferenced (key masked, page clamped). Eviction stays compatible: evicted pages hold only keys <= p_min - W, never key_ok; all G3 eviction tests (NaN-poisoned freed pages, reuse by another sequence) pass and the digest case local/paged_decode_evicted is bit-identical to f91e8b6. REPORT Design paragraph and strict_gated_attention_fwd_paged docstring corrected. Tests: test_device_checks_fail_closed[page_minus1_visible, page_out_of_range, seq_lens_beyond_table], test_host_validation_paged_seq_lens.

Varlen: 0 <= q_pos < len_k per row in the kernel (HEAD and TOKEN tiles) and in validate_varlen_packing; paged: positions are derived in the kernel from seq_lens with len_q <= seq_lens checked, so they cannot be negative. Contiguity is not required by the forward (a subset of positions stays valid and is tested); the autograd path (training) enforces the backward's contiguity rule in the forward via prepare_sequence_meta. Tests test_host_validation_rejects_q_pos_outside_keys[global,local], test_device_checks_fail_closed[q_pos_beyond_keys, q_pos_negative, seq_lens_below_len_q] fail on f91e8b6, pass here.
